run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a transformer model with a GPTQModifier recipe for mixed int4 and int8
build_load_model: build a transformer causal language model from a pretrained HuggingFace checkpoint with auto dtype
test_load_dataset: test loading a HuggingFace dataset split and shuffling calibration samples for quantization
create_preprocess_dataset: create a dataset preprocessing pipeline that applies chat templates and tokenizes text samples
run_dispatch_model: run dispatch_model to offload a quantized model for inference on available devices
